title: kith-peer: make DeliverClient pub + outbox_worker generic
description:
What: Make the DeliverClient trait public and outbox_worker generic over any client, so integration tests can inject a PeerHttpClient with custom TLS roots.

Algorithm:
1. In kith-peer/src/lib.rs: change 'pub(crate) trait DeliverClient' to 'pub trait DeliverClient'
2. Change outbox_worker signature from (store, client: PeerHttpClient, owner_id) to generic: outbox_worker<C: DeliverClient + Send + 'static>(store, client: C, owner_id)
3. Verify all method bounds on DeliverClient's async fn compile with the new generic (add + Send on Future output if needed)
4. In kithd/src/main.rs: the call outbox_worker(store, PeerHttpClient::new(), owner_id) still compiles; PeerHttpClient: DeliverClient is already the concrete impl
5. Do not change MockDeliverClient visibility (stays pub(crate) in tests, not needed externally)
6. Run cargo check + cargo test -p kith-peer to verify no regressions

Defensive programming:
- outbox_worker return type is '!' (diverging); preserve this in the generic signature
- Do not change PeerHttpClient behavior; it remains the production implementation
- Ensure MockDeliverClient is NOT accidentally made pub (would expose test internals)

Tests: cargo test -p kith-peer passes unchanged (existing tests still use PeerHttpClient directly)
